recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future work group wants a canonical ValueSet or CodeSystem for HTTP response status codes, that should be handled as a new terminology/design decision rather than inferred from FHIR-6109.
issue_request: FHIR-6109 was Published/Persuasive and asked for a ValueSet with HTTP codes. The description linked to HTTP status codes, while the recorded resolution points to http-verb.html and the comments say the work was done as part of another task.
initial_application: No git commit was found that explicitly mentions FHIR-6109. Historical commit f5a4865af0 added the HTTPVerb binding, #http-verb binding row, and http-verb worksheet to the Bundle spreadsheet; later source refactors carried that content into source/bundle/valueset-http-verb.xml and source/bundle/codesystem-http-verb.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists bundle=Bundle as an active resource. Current source defines CodeSystem/http-verb and ValueSet/http-verb and binds Bundle.entry.request.method to the ValueSet with required strength. The HTTP status-code guidance in source/http.html is separate prose that allows other HTTP status codes where appropriate; bounded Jira, Zulip, Confluence, and source searches found no final later decision requiring a distinct finite HTTP response status-code ValueSet for this issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the current specification already contains and uses the HTTP verb ValueSet targeted by the Jira resolution.
